draftImport.instruction: Use the separate V2 session ID, declare prior_exposure and import only the V2 review JSON. Keep the V1 session untouched. Download any existing V2 work before replacing its draft. The versioned IDs identify the same human; other humans use their own blank review sessions and truthful exposure declarations.

tasks.action: Name the stationary reference frame used for Front C's headward description and, when needed for later anatomical mapping, describe A versus B at that frame. Use an existing visible original frame; no numerical reference-frame interval was supplied. Do not recreate or swap the physical IDs, infer left/right, or repeat the full tracking pass.

firstAction: Check Front C at original frames 4 and 11 around its confirmed touchdown range 5–10, record support state/visibility/continuity only if visible, then export a new partial review. If unclear, leave UNKNOWN.

unknownCoverage.initialStatePolicy: Frame 0 need not be labeled to use later verified frames; leave unneeded prefixes/tails UNKNOWN and masked.

reuse.instruction: Retain B/D event ranges without another event-occurrence pass. Neither V1 nor V2 supplies definite frame states; reuse the reported event evidence only, not imagined frame labels.

nextTrainingStep: Turn selected flanking-frame checks into saved explicit human support states; later apply the existing anatomical mapping, independence/reconciliation and dog/split gates. Keep unverified targets masked. Front C/D supervised pair conversion still requires explicit provenance-preserving support.
